result.title: Certified Comparative Statics for Conservation-Law Equilibrium Layers, with an Application to RNA Interference
result.summary: Implicit and equilibrium neural layers define their output as the fixed point of a map. Existing theory certifies that this fixed point exists; it does not certify how it responds to its inputs. For a conservation-law layer with order-preserving coupling we give a form-independent answer: every input-output comparative static is sign-certified if and only if the residual Jacobian is a nonsingular M-matrix, and the certified sign depends only on the sign of the occupancy derivative, so one guarantee covers Langmuir, Hill, and saturating-exponential occupancies. The M-matrix machinery is classical; the contribution is form-independence as the portable invariant, the first certified-sign sensitivity result for a layer of this class, and a sharp phase boundary at which certification is lost while the equilibrium remains well posed. Three consequences follow: the phase boundary, which is strictly stronger than the M-matrix condition; competitive derepression, whose derivative is identically zero for any independent per-target scorer and provably nonzero here; and non-submodularity of resource-coupled suppression. We instantiate on siRNA off-target competition and validate on real public data only, across seventeen microRNAs, two titration studies, and a paired chemical-modification experiment; a second, non-biological instantiation shows the same certified sign on measured physical data. As a trainable layer the operator learns end-to-end while remaining certified-monotone by construction, reaching magnitude parity with a parameter-matched feedforward baseline while expressing a competition effect that baseline cannot represent for any weights. The single-pool instantiation validates the mechanism but does not rank off-target magnitude or resolve position-specific design. Code: https://github.com/shadi97kh/certified-equilibrium-layers

AI.brief_summary: 研究守恒律平衡层（隐式层）比较静态的符号认证：证明当残差 Jacobian 为非奇异 M-matrix 时输入—输出灵敏度符号可被认证，并给出失效的相边界，在 siRNA 脱靶竞争等真实数据上验证；作为可训练层可在端到端学习中保持认证单调性。
AI.relevance_reason: 隐式固定点层的灵敏度符号认证与「按构造保持单调」可能为 LVR 中循环推理状态如何随视觉证据更新、以及输入到输出的贡献分配提供可核查线索，但其研究对象是平衡层与生化竞争，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。
